tips.text: Run Tier 5 Mother bounties; two or three runs hit the daily standing cap.
Keep 16,000 standing for Otak's two gem blueprints before buying all four Lavos blueprints.
Pick up your Argon Crystals only when the rest of the Chassis is ready; they decay within 24 hours.
Nobody calls the Lavos farm a grind; it is a straight standing purchase with no RNG.
Expect the daily standing cap, not drops, to set the pace.
